items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Oh the Army, that's right. You told me that.

ctx.x: What year was this to people? Oh geez.

21, I think it was 1921. 21. It was before I went to the Dreamland with this trumpet business. About six months before that. So how did you happen to play trumpet? Army. Oh the Army, that's right. You told me that.
How old were you in those days?
